hypothesis: The manuscript Section 2 periodic forced-occurrence lower bound is sound on every tiny oracle instance and increases 2-factor certification coverage of an existing greedy SCS assembler by at least 10 percentage points over extension-only counts.

input.generator: all combinations of up to 3 distinct nonempty binary strings of length at most 3, plus 40 seeded 4-string DNA-like instances of length 6

baseline: extension-only count recursion, with identical greedy assembled output
judge: independent exhaustive permutation oracle; per-substring occurrences in optimal superstring
failure: any lower bound exceeding exact optimum or occurrence count; or coverage gain below target
limits: Synthetic, tiny instances; no full manuscript 2-approximation implementation; no genomic accuracy claim; no tuning after this specification.
